stem.text: The following trace is seen on the screen of a cathode-ray oscilloscope.

stem.alt: Oscilloscope screen grid showing a wave with two peaks and two troughs.

stem.text: The setting of the time-base is then changed from $10\,\text{ms cm}^{-1}$ to $20\,\text{ms cm}^{-1}$ and the Y-plate sensitivity remains constant.
Which trace is now seen on the screen?

A.alt: Oscilloscope screen grid showing a wave with two peaks and two troughs, drawn more widely spaced than the stem trace.

B.alt: Oscilloscope screen grid showing a single wave with one peak and one trough.

C.alt: Oscilloscope screen grid showing a wave with four peaks and four troughs.

D.alt: Oscilloscope screen grid showing a single wave with one peak and one trough, drawn more widely spaced than the stem trace.
